Here’s a ready-to-send promotional newsletter you can adapt for Green Earth Nonprofit’s Annual Earth Day Gala.

Subject line options (pick one)
- Celebrate Earth Day in Style: Join Our Annual Gala
- One Night for a Greener Tomorrow—RSVP for the Earth Day Gala
- Your Impact Starts Here: Tickets for the Earth Day Gala
- Dine, Connect, and Restore: Earth Day Gala Tickets Inside
- Make Every Moment Matter: Support the Earth Day Gala

Preheader options
- An evening of purpose, community, and real climate impact.
- Reserve your seat—limited early-bird tickets available.
- Celebrate progress and fuel the next chapter of climate action.

Email body
Hi [First Name],

This Earth Day, let’s celebrate what we’ve achieved together—and power what comes next. Join Green Earth Nonprofit for our Annual Earth Day Gala: an evening of community, inspiration, and direct support for the programs protecting our forests, oceans, and communities most impacted by climate change.

Event details
- Date: [Day], [Month] [Date], [Year]
- Time: [Start]–[End] [Time Zone]
- Location: [Venue Name], [Street Address], [City]
- Dress: Eco-chic or cocktail attire
- Getting there: Easy access by public transit; limited bike valet; discounted rideshare available
- Accessibility: Wheelchair accessible; ASL interpretation available upon request (please email [accessibility@greenearth.org] by [date])

What your ticket supports
- Restoring [X] acres of native habitat in [region]
- Deploying community solar for [X] households
- Expanding zero-waste education to [X] students
- Planting [X] climate-resilient trees with local partners

Sustainability at the gala
- Zero-waste service with reusable ware and curated composting
- Plant-forward, locally sourced menu; surplus food rescued to local shelters
- Carbon-neutral event with verified offsets and transparent reporting
- Digital programs and QR codes to reduce paper waste

Program highlights
- Keynote by [Speaker Name], [Title/Org]
- Fireside chat with frontline community leaders
- Live music by [Performer]
- Silent auction featuring eco-experiences and sustainable brands

Tickets
- Early-bird (through [date]): $[price] – limited quantity
- General admission: $[price]
- Patron table (10 seats): $[price] with recognition
- Sliding-scale community tickets available—no one turned away (apply at [link])

Reserve your seat: [RSVP Link]
Add to calendar: [Google Calendar Link] | [ICS Link]

Can’t attend?
- Make a tax-deductible gift: [Donate Link]
- Sponsor a community ticket: $[amount] funds access for one local advocate
- Start a peer-to-peer fundraiser: [P2P Link]

Volunteer opportunities
- Join our zero-waste crew, registration team, or décor setup
- Sign up: [Volunteer Link] (brief orientation provided)

Double your impact
- Many employers match gifts and volunteer hours. Check eligibility: [Matching Tool Link]

Thank you for standing with us. Together, we’re transforming passion into measurable climate solutions.

With gratitude,
The Green Earth Nonprofit Team
[Website] | [Instagram] | [Facebook] | [Twitter/X]
Questions? Contact us at [events@greenearth.org] or [phone number]

P.S. Early-bird pricing ends [date]. Seats sell out each year—reserve yours today: [RSVP Link]

Footer
- You’re receiving this because you opted in at [event/site]. Update preferences: [Manage Preferences Link]. Unsubscribe: [Unsubscribe Link].
- Green Earth Nonprofit, [Address]. Tax ID: [EIN]. Donations are tax-deductible as allowed by law.

Optional content blocks you can A/B test
- Impact spotlight: “Last year’s gala funded [result], reducing [X] tons CO2e.”
- Donor testimonial: “[Quote],” —[Name], longtime supporter
- Visual block: Before/after habitat restoration image (alt text: “Restored wetland thriving with native plants”)

Tips for sending
- Send time: Weekday 9–11 a.m. local time for best open rates
- Resend to non-openers 48 hours later with a different subject line
- Include a plain-text version with the RSVP and Donate links clearly visible
